product_one_liner.value: TwelveLabs provides video-intelligence APIs that let developers and enterprise teams search, analyze, and embed video using natural language and multimodal inputs.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes its product as a video-native AI/API platform for searching, analyzing, and embedding video, and identifies developers and enterprise teams in multiple industries as users.

pricing_page.notes: The public /pricing page is titled as a pricing page and presents plans, including a free start and a choice of plan as usage grows.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: TwelveLabs has a case study describing its work with SBS and another naming Dyn Sport; both are presented as customers using its product. | named_customers.0: The case study identifies SBS as an organization using TwelveLabs models. | named_customers.1: The case study names Dyn Sport as a customer using TwelveLabs video intelligence.

employee_band.notes: The reported 173 employees falls within the 101-200 band. Other counts differ slightly but also fit this band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The LinkedIn company profile and a TwelveLabs job listing both identify San Francisco as headquarters. | hq_country: The company LinkedIn profile identifies its headquarters as San Francisco, California, and gives the address country as US; its job listing also describes San Francisco as headquarters. I use United States for the country.

founded_year.notes: The company LinkedIn profile gives its founding year as 2021.

eng_blog.notes: The company blog has at least two technical posts by engineers: one describing rebuilding its HLS video pipeline, and another explaining an architectural redesign of video indexing. Both discuss how the product infrastructure is built.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation provides multiple quickstarts, comprehensive guides, an API reference, and SDK documentation, meeting the threshold for public product documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The open jobs listing includes a Staff ML Research Engineer role and a Senior Machine Learning Engineer role, both matching the requested AI/ML job titles.

model_provider.value: TwelveLabs' Marengo embedding model and Pegasus generative model.
model_provider.notes: The product documentation names Marengo as its embedding model and Pegasus as its generative model, which are the publicly identified models used by the product.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The company enterprise security page explicitly claims SOC 2 Type II certification; it does not name another certification in this cited claim. | compliance_certs.0: The company enterprise security page expressly names SOC 2 Type II.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The funding profiles identify the latest round as Series B. | funding_date: The latest round is dated July 1, 2026, which corresponds to YYYY-MM value 2026-07; the date is also shown on the company funding announcement. | funding_amount_usd: The funding profile identifies the latest round amount as USD 100 million; the company announcement also says it raised $100 million.

raised_18mo.notes: The company announced a $100 million funding round on July 1, 2026; this date is within the 18 months preceding November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The company’s current job posting is explicitly titled Sales Development Representative, Emerging Verticals and describes the SDR role.

launched_6mo.notes: On October 6, 2026, TwelveLabs announced the release of Pegasus 1.6 with new physical-AI capabilities, inside the six-month window before November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: The business systems job listing explicitly identifies HubSpot as the CRM in TwelveLabs’ stack. | crm_stack_signal.0: The job listing explicitly names HubSpot as the company CRM.
